## Goal
Evidence is written from five places and read from two, but no guide follows one piece of proof from creation to the report. docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE.md:44,51 lists the kinds only.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Follows each writer: mailbox replies (`src/freemyid/engine/runner.py:209-227`), attestations (`src/freemyid/engine/handoff.py:206-220`), call notes and receipts (`src/freemyid/wizard/proof_input.py:46-65`), letter copies saved when an email is queued (`src/freemyid/engine/outbox.py:367-369`), and the signed authorization (`src/freemyid/wizard/draft.py:550-557`, `src/freemyid/consent.py:31,44-52`).
2. Explains storage at the level of "saved encrypted through `Store.save_evidence`" (`src/freemyid/storage/db.py:309-322`) with no key or cipher detail; viewing (`src/freemyid/wizard/server.py:336-354`); the report (`src/freemyid/wizard/report.py:26-86`); and what `freemyid wipe` removes (`src/freemyid/paths.py:31-34`).
3. Links to docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE.md instead of repeating it; ends with "What this guide does not cover" (key handling and secrets are in-house only).

Plain English for developers; every claim about the code carries an inline `path:line` citation in the format `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_source_citations.py` parses. Describe what the code does today; anything unreleased is "coming". No key, cipher or secret-handling details (in-house only, docs/VENDOR.md). No real personal data. Offline: no network, no git, no installs.
